design_guidelines.md.content:
# Nepal Science Navigators (NSN) Science Fair Website - Design Guidelines

## Design Approach
**Custom NSN Theme** - Futuristic science-inspired design with unique identity (NOT generic or Rotary-style)

## Color Palette
- **Deep Space Blue**: #0A1A3A (Primary backgrounds, headers)
- **Aurora Cyan**: #1ECBE1 (Accent, CTAs, highlights)
- **Stellar White**: #F5FAFF (Text, cards, content backgrounds)
- **Solar Gold**: #D7A028 (Secondary accent, awards, highlights)
- **Planet Grey**: #8A8FA3 (Secondary text, borders, subtle elements)

## Visual Style
- Soft gradients with subtle color transitions
- Glow effects on interactive elements and accents
- Thin neon borders (Aurora Cyan) on cards and sections
- Smooth shadows with depth
- Rounded layouts throughout (border-radius: 12-24px)
- Minimal clutter with generous whitespace
- Modern scientific aesthetic

## Typography
- **Headings**: Poppins or Montserrat (bold, modern, impactful)
- **Body Text**: Inter (clean, highly readable)
- Consistent hierarchy with clear size differentiation

## Layout System
- Tailwind spacing: Primarily use units of 4, 6, 8, 12, 16 for consistency
- Container max-widths: max-w-7xl for main content areas
- Responsive grid systems for cards and content sections

## Motion & Animation Strategy
**Every UI element must have smooth, professional motion:**
- Page load transitions (fade-in, slide-up)
- Section animations (slide/fade on scroll)
- Button hover effects (scale, glow, shadow lift)
- Card hover animations (lift-up transform with shadow expansion)
- Menu open/close (smooth slide with fade)
- Image zoom on hover (subtle scale transform)
- Input focus animations (border glow, label float)
- Dashboard table row animations (stagger on load)
- Gallery lightbox (fade + scale)
- Hero text effects (typing animation or staggered fade-in)
- Statistics counter animations (count-up effect)
- Smooth scroll behavior throughout

**Animation principles:**
- Use Framer Motion for React components
- Easing: easeOut, spring physics
- Duration: 200-400ms for micro-interactions, 600-800ms for transitions
- No lag or jitter - optimize performance

## Page-Specific Designs

### Home
- Animated hero section with futuristic background treatment
- Hero text with typing or fade animation
- Premium banners with Aurora Cyan accents
- Animated statistics counters (number count-up effect)
- Upcoming events card with hover effects
- All sections with motion-enhanced entry

### About
- Animated founder highlight section with image and bio
- Mission/vision cards with fade-in stagger
- Animated timeline for history
- Board of Directors grid (3-7 members) with hover lift effects

### Categories
- Science category cards (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Coding, Robotics, Environment)
- Category icons with Aurora Cyan glow on hover
- Card lift and shadow expansion on hover

### Schedule
- Animated vertical timeline design
- Collapsible session cards
- Judges list with profile cards
- Time-based visual indicators

### Gallery
- Masonry grid layout (12-20 images)
- Animated category filtering
- Lightbox with zoom-in animation and smooth transitions
- Image hover with zoom effect

### Blog
- Blog article cards (3-6 mock articles)
- Animated card hover with lift effect
- Detailed blog view with smooth transitions

### News
- Science news cards (4-8 entries)
- External link buttons with animation
- Card hover effects

### Notices
- Pinned notices at top
- Urgent notices with Aurora Cyan pulse effect
- Card-based layout with priority indicators

### Videos
- Embedded YouTube videos (3 sample links)
- Animated thumbnail hover effects
- Grid layout

### Contact
- Contact form with input focus animations (glow, label float)
- Embedded map
- Contact information cards
- Submit button with loading animation

## Component Library

### Navigation
- Sticky header with blur backdrop
- Animated menu items
- Mobile hamburger with smooth slide animation
- Aurora Cyan active state indicators

### Cards
- Rounded corners (16-20px)
- Thin neon borders with Aurora Cyan
- Soft shadows
- Hover: lift transform + shadow expansion
- Smooth transitions

### Buttons
- Primary: Aurora Cyan background with glow effect
- Secondary: Solar Gold accents
- Hover: scale transform + intensified glow
- Active state with subtle press effect
- Blurred backgrounds when on images

### Forms
- Floating labels
- Aurora Cyan focus glow on inputs
- Smooth validation animations
- Autosave indicator animations

### Dashboard Specific
- Animated sidebar navigation
- Live preview panel
- Rich text editor interface
- Modal dialogs with fade + scale entrance
- Table row stagger animations
- Drag-and-drop with smooth feedback

## Images
- **Hero Section**: Large, futuristic science-themed background image with overlay gradient (Deep Space Blue to transparent)
- **About Page**: Founder portrait, BOD member photos
- **Gallery**: 12-20 science fair event photos in masonry layout
- **Blog**: Featured images for articles
- All images with subtle zoom on hover

## Footer
- Multi-column layout
- Social links with hover animations
- Newsletter signup with animated input
- Deep Space Blue background with subtle gradient

replit.md.content:
# Nepal Science Navigators (NSN) Science Fair Website

A comprehensive full-stack website for Nepal's premier science fair competition, featuring custom futuristic branding, complete CMS functionality, and beautiful Framer Motion animations throughout.

## Project Overview

**Purpose**: Science fair competition platform for students to showcase innovative projects in physics, chemistry, biology, computer science, robotics, and environmental science.

**Tech Stack**: React + TypeScript + Express.js + Wouter routing + TanStack Query + Framer Motion + Tailwind CSS + Shadcn UI

**Current State**: Fully functional MVP with 10 public pages, admin dashboard, and comprehensive backend API

## Design System

### Custom NSN Colors
- **Aurora Cyan** (#1ECBE1): Primary accent for highlights, CTAs, and interactive elements
- **Solar Gold** (#D7A028): Secondary accent for contrast and energy
- **Deep Space Blue** (#0A1A3A): Primary dark background (space, space-700, space-900)
- **Stellar White** (#F5FAFF): Text on dark backgrounds
- **Planet Grey** (#8A8FA3): Muted text and subtle elements

### Typography
- **Headings**: Poppins (font-heading) - Bold, modern sans-serif
- **Body**: Inter - Clean, highly readable

### Animation Strategy
Every UI element features Framer Motion animations:
- Page transitions with fade-in and slide-up effects
- Hover effects on cards with lift and glow
- Scroll-triggered animations for sections
- Pulsing effects on urgent notices
- Smooth number counters on statistics
- Staggered animations for lists and grids

## Project Structure

### Frontend Pages (10 total)

1. **Home** (`/`) - Hero section with animated statistics, featured categories, upcoming events
2. **About** (`/about`) - Founder profile, mission/vision, Board of Directors grid, organization history
3. **Categories** (`/categories`) - 6 science categories with glowing card effects
4. **Schedule** (`/schedule`) - Event timeline with session details and registration info
5. **Blog** (`/blog`) - Article cards with featured images and author info
6. **Gallery** (`/gallery`) - Masonry grid layout with category filtering
7. **News** (`/news`) - Latest science news with external links
8. **Notices** (`/notices`) - Announcements with pinned and urgent indicators
9. **Videos** (`/videos`) - YouTube embeds showcasing event highlights
10. **Contact** (`/contact`) - Contact form, info cards, embedded map

### Admin Dashboard (`/admin`)
- Sidebar navigation with 12 sections
- Dashboard overview with statistics cards
- Messages panel showing contact form submissions
- CMS placeholder sections for all content types
- Live unread message counter

### Backend API Endpoints

All endpoints use `/api/` prefix:

**Content Management**:
- `GET/POST /home` - Hero content and statistics
- `GET/POST /about` - Founder, mission, vision
- `GET/POST /footer` - Footer contact info and social links

**Collections** (with DELETE support):
- `/board-members` - Board of Directors
- `/categories` - Science categories
- `/schedule` - Event timeline
- `/judges` - Competition judges
- `/gallery` - Photo gallery
- `/blog` - Blog posts
- `/news` - News articles
- `/notices` - Announcements (with PATCH for updates)
- `/videos` - Video gallery

**User Interaction**:
- `POST /contact` - Submit contact form
- `GET /contact-messages` - Fetch all messages (admin)
- `PATCH /contact-messages/:id/read` - Mark message as read

## Data Models

See `shared/schema.ts` for complete schema definitions using Drizzle ORM and Zod validation.

Key models:
- `HomeContent` - Hero section data
- `AboutContent` - Founder and organization info
- `BoardMember` - BOD profiles
- `Category` - Science categories
- `ScheduleItem` - Event timeline
- `Judge` - Competition judges
- `GalleryImage` - Photo gallery
- `BlogPost` - Articles
- `News` - News items
- `Notice` - Announcements
- `Video` - YouTube videos
- `ContactMessage` - Form submissions
- `FooterContent` - Footer data

## Storage

Using **in-memory storage** (MemStorage) for MVP simplicity.

**Preloaded Mock Data**:
- 6 board members
- 6 science categories
- 8 schedule sessions (2-day event)
- 3 judges
- 16 gallery images
- 3 blog posts
- 2 news articles
- 3 notices (2 pinned)
- 3 videos

All mock data is initialized automatically on server start.

## Key Features

### Animations
- Page load animations with staggered reveals
- Hover effects on all interactive elements
- Scroll-triggered animations using Framer Motion viewport detection
- Card lifts and glows on hover
- Button scale and translation effects
- Pulsing indicators for urgent content
- Smooth number counting animations

### Responsive Design
- Mobile-first approach
- Breakpoints: sm (640px), md (768px), lg (1024px), xl (1280px)
- Flexible grid layouts that adapt to screen size
- Masonry gallery on desktop, stacked cards on mobile

### Admin Features
- Sidebar navigation with icons
- Message management with unread indicators
- Dashboard statistics overview
- CMS placeholders for future content editing
- Role-based access ready (authentication not yet implemented)

## Development Workflow

### Running the Project
```bash
npm run dev
```
Starts both Express backend (port 5000) and Vite frontend dev server.

### Project Commands
- `npm run dev` - Start development server
- Workflow: "Start application" - Configured to run `npm run dev`

### Environment
- **Runtime**: Replit (NixOS)
- **Node Version**: 20.x
- **Database**: In-memory storage (no external DB required for MVP)

## Future Enhancements

### Planned Features
1. **Authentication System** - User registration, login, role-based access (Admin, Judge, Volunteer, Participant)
2. **File Upload** - Image uploads for gallery, blog, and user avatars
3. **Rich Text Editor** - WYSIWYG editing for blog posts and page content
4. **Advanced Admin CMS** - Full CRUD interfaces for all content types
5. **Search Functionality** - Search across blog posts, news, and galleries
6. **Filtering & Sorting** - Category filters, date sorting, tag system
7. **Comments System** - User comments on blog posts
8. **Registration System** - Student/team registration for science fair
9. **Project Submissions** - Online submission system for projects
10. **Judging Portal** - Scoring interface for judges
11. **Email Integration** - Automated emails for contact form submissions
12. **Analytics Dashboard** - Traffic stats, submission metrics

### Technical Debt
- Replace in-memory storage with PostgreSQL database
- Add comprehensive error handling
- Implement API rate limiting
- Add input sanitization
- Create comprehensive test suite
- Add accessibility improvements (ARIA labels, keyboard navigation)
- Optimize images with lazy loading
- Add SEO meta tags to all pages
- Implement dark mode toggle

## Code Conventions

### Styling
- Tailwind utility classes for all styling
- Shadcn UI components for consistency
- Custom color tokens in `tailwind.config.ts`
- Responsive design with mobile-first approach

### Component Structure
- Functional components with TypeScript
- TanStack Query for all data fetching
- React Hook Form with Zod validation for forms
- Framer Motion for all animations
- Lucide React icons throughout

### Data Flow
1. Frontend makes request via TanStack Query
2. Query uses default fetcher (configured in queryClient)
3. Backend validates with Zod schemas
4. Storage layer handles CRUD operations
5. Response sent back to frontend
6. Query cache invalidated on mutations

## Testing Strategy

### Manual Testing Checklist
- [ ] All 10 public pages load without errors
- [ ] Navigation works across all routes
- [ ] Footer displays on all non-admin pages
- [ ] Contact form submits successfully
- [ ] Admin dashboard loads and displays stats
- [ ] Messages panel shows contact submissions
- [ ] All API endpoints return correct data
- [ ] Animations play smoothly
- [ ] Mobile responsive on all breakpoints

### Future Automated Testing
- Unit tests for utilities and helpers
- Integration tests for API endpoints
- E2E tests with Playwright for critical user flows
- Visual regression testing

## Deployment Notes

### Replit Deployment
- Frontend and backend served from same origin (no CORS issues)
- Vite config handles development and production builds
- Environment variables managed through Replit Secrets
- Automatic HTTPS on published domain

### Performance Considerations
- Code splitting with React lazy loading (future)
- Image optimization needed
- CDN for static assets (future)
- Database connection pooling when migrating to PostgreSQL

## Contact & Support

**Project Type**: Science Fair Competition Platform
**Framework**: Full-stack JavaScript (React + Express)
**Storage**: In-memory (MemStorage)
**Primary Use Case**: Educational event management and student showcase

## Recent Changes (November 25, 2025)

### Completed Implementation
1. ✅ Complete data schema with 12+ models
2. ✅ All 10 public-facing pages with Framer Motion animations
3. ✅ Navigation and Footer components
4. ✅ Admin dashboard with sidebar and message management
5. ✅ Complete backend API with all endpoints
6. ✅ In-memory storage with comprehensive mock data
7. ✅ Contact form with message persistence
8. ✅ Responsive design across all breakpoints

### Known Issues
- None at this time

### Next Steps
1. Add rich text editor for blog post content
2. Implement user authentication system
3. Create full CMS interfaces for admin panel
4. Add file upload functionality
5. Migrate to PostgreSQL database
